description: A wiki page's HISTORY: everything that happened to it in one list, newest first — each text version (created, edited, renamed, restored, an agent's proposal accepted), comments, approvals, required reading, reviews and answers to their remarks, deprecation marks, the page opened to somebody off its project, its secrets and secret files, embeds, files. Each row says 'kind' (text, comments, approval, reading, review, deprecation, secrets, access, other), 'type' (what happened), 'at', 'actor', 'via' — the door: ui (a person's screen), voice, api, mcp, agent, system; null where it was not recorded — and the facts it has: 'version', 'subject' (whom or what it is about), 'detail', 'note'. You see only rows about what you may see: a secret file's rows only if you manage that file, a secret's readings only if you may change it, who read the page only if you lead its project; never a secret's value. 'kinds' narrows it ('approval,review'); 'before' is the 'next' of the previous call to go further back. For a version's text and what changed, see get_wiki_page with its version.

before.description: The 'next' the previous call answered, to read further back. Omit for the newest.

kinds.description: Only these kinds, comma-separated: text, comments, approval, reading, review, deprecation, secrets, access, other. Omit for all.

name: get_wiki_page_history
title: Get wiki page history
